items.title: California's billionaire tax on track for defeat as the state continues to count votes
items.summary: The referendum would amend California's constitution and impose a one-time 5% tax on California residents and trusts with assets over $1 billion.

items.title: Why Elon Musk will keep funding Grok, no matter the cost
items.summary: In the Loop Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen sets the table for why he believes Elon Musk is willing to keep pouring money into his AI project, Grok, no matter the cost. Ahamadeen explains why he believes personal AI assistants will become the “most important and valuable layer” for how people interact with the broader digital world.

items.title: Dow Jones Futures Rise, Techs Fall; Apple, Microsoft, Amazon Flash Buy Signals In Postelection Rally
items.summary: Elections and diving oil prices sparked a stock market surge. Stocks from many sectors flash buy signals, but avoid this area.

items.title: Has Alphabet (GOOGL) Fallen Far Enough To Back Its Cash Flow Value?
items.summary: Alphabet has just come through a bruising stretch, with heavy AI spending, negative free cash flow and a sharp pullback in the share price raising a simple question for you as an investor: Is the current valuation still supported by the cash the business can generate, or has the story moved ahead of the underlying cash flows? Over the past 3 years, Alphabet has returned 121.2%, which puts a lot of accumulated optimism on the line when you ask whether the recent slide has fully reset...

items.title: Amazon’s Zoox Plans to Start Testing in Europe and Asia
items.summary: Amazon-owned Zoox plans to send a test-fleet of data-collection vehicles to Europe and Asia as the first step of a global expansion, the autonomous vehicle company’s chief executive, Aicha Evans, announced Wednesday at the WSJ Tech event.
